WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
), above_average AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.avg_hgb AS above_overall
    FROM patient_averages p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average o
    WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.avg_hgb
)
SELECT ID,
       avg_hgb,
       above_overall,
       avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM above_average) AS difference_from_above_average_mean
FROM above_average
ORDER BY difference_from_above_average_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
